summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Ermenegildo Zegna N.V., a foreign private issuer, announcing a planned release of preliminary first-half 2026 revenues on July 23, 2026, along with a conference call. The filing contains only a routine earnings press release and does not describe any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. As such, it does not meet the criteria for a special-situation categorization.
